$comment: SEC-META-01 pending allowlist: every security-guide SEC id without a shipped test MUST map to its owning task file (security-guide §2.1.4-5). The owning task file MUST declare the id on its "**SEC ids owned by THIS task:**" marker line — a prose mention does not confer ownership, and a task naming an id only to disclaim it fails the gate. Entries are removed when the owning task ships a verbatim-id test title; task 28 requires this file empty. An id that is BOTH titled and listed here fails the gate: the row and the title cannot both be true. — SEC-AUTH-09 (task 28): DISCHARGED 2026-07-25 (removed from this allowlist; titled verbatim by packages/harness/test/security/sec-auth-09.test.ts). All three legs are now proven. LEG 2 (no pushed op payload carries verifier material) — packages/harness/test/security/sec-auth-09-payloads.test.ts, titled for invariant I-13, with its planted-byte positive control (T-14b). LEG 3 (the PIN-verifier comparison is constant-time) — @bolusi/core `timingSafeEqualBytes` is the canonical accumulate-then-compare (length folded into the accumulator, no short-circuit, one terminal compare) and is the compare on the verify path (`verifyPinAgainst`); structure + behaviour asserted in packages/core/test/auth/verifier.test.ts and re-checked under the SEC-AUTH-09 title. LEG 1 (the verifier salt/hash/params are ciphertext AT REST on real hardware) — proven ON DEVICE by emulator run 30153400999: reports/device-gates/2026-07-25-emulator.json records SEC-AUTH-09-leg1 = pass, driven through the production `writeVerifier` (task 178; rev-178 falsified it by un-sealing the writer → the gate went red naming user_pin_verifiers.hash). The per-push release gate cannot run the emulator, so it reads that COMMITTED artifact under a git-provenance/staleness guard (packages/harness/src/security/device-gate-provenance.ts): it anchors on the artifact's introducing commit, requires that commit to have smuggled no at-rest code change, goes RED if ANY at-rest surface file (the column cipher / `writeVerifier` / the on-device gate body / the seed / the probe) changed since — demanding a fresh emulator run rather than trusting a stale artifact — goes RED on a hand-edited artifact (working tree ≠ committed bytes), and requires SEC-AUTH-09-leg1 = pass in the committed bytes. Because a titled id must NOT also be listed here (the row and the title cannot both be true), the row is removed. KNOWN RESIDUAL, surfaced to the owner: the artifact carries no self-declared build sha, so the freshness anchor is git provenance; a malicious insider who commits a fully fabricated NEW artifact file is a higher threat class no git-only scheme closes — the durable fix is for the emulator producer to record the build sha inside the artifact. — SEC-AUTH-10 (task 27): RECORDED REASON, updated 2026-07-22 for D21 (`ai-docs/decisions/2026-07-22-assume-device-performance-passes.md`). The owner ruled that 27b's Part C performance gates are ASSUMED to pass on the physical 2 GB device. That resolves the DECISIONS the P-4 benchmark informed (D8 keeps the argon2id default m=32768/t=3/p=1; D6 ratified) — but it does NOT discharge this id. SEC-AUTH-10's acceptance (security-guide) is a RECORDED ON-DEVICE BENCHMARK COMMITTED AS A BUILD ARTIFACT, and an assumption produces no artifact: nothing has run, no p95 exists, and `reports/device-gates/` holds no physical-device capture. So the row STAYS, owned by task 27, until a real device produces the artifact. Do NOT retire it against a test that merely pins the params — that is moving the yardstick to reach green (CLAUDE.md §2.11), and it would convert an accepted, visible risk into a false assurance. D21 changed what BLOCKS v0, not what has been measured.
